engine.coordinates: axial hex (q, r); q in [0, width), r in [0, height)
engine.cover: each land tile's share under each cover class, in cover_classes order, in basis points summing to 10000; empty for water
engine.river: a tile's river flag means a river runs along at least one of its borders; hydrology.json lists each river border (between tiles a and b), its flow, and the tile at the corner it flows toward; flow at or above deep_flow is a deep river
engine.sites: sites.json lists ore deposits, quarries, ancient ruins and troves placed when the world was made; the same kit for each civilization

travel.note: world rule: tile centres lie a day's walk apart; costs are in tenths of a day, null where it cannot be done on foot

engine_day0.note: Settlements and founder counts that exist before any day is simulated.

presentation.note: Display constants only. They have no simulation meaning.
